hero.intro: Computer Science engineer focused on <hl>mobile development (Flutter, React Native)</hl>, <hl>backend services (Elixir/Ash, Node.js)</hl> and <hl>AI-assisted development workflows</hl>. Currently at Lambdo and building FinlyCR, my personal-finance app on Google Play.

finly.tagline: Personal finance platform · web and mobile
finly.description: Full-stack app for personal finance management: income, expenses, loans and subscriptions, with a charts dashboard, offline mode with a sync queue and personal/family multi-tenancy. Web in Next.js and a mobile app in Expo/React Native published on Google Play, over a single Turso database.

community.title: Community · iTOVi × Droplii
community.tagline: Social module for a production mobile app
community.description: I'm currently building the Community social module end to end on a BLoC architecture: feed, profiles, social following, advanced search and content creation. I integrate the client with a GraphQL API (Elixir/Ash) and have implemented an AI conversational assistant for content recommendation with intent detection.

symphony.title: Symphony · AI agent orchestrator
symphony.description: Adapted and extended Symphony (open source, Apache 2.0) into an orchestrator in Elixir/OTP + Phoenix LiveView that detects tasks, spins up isolated per-issue workspaces and launches agents (Codex/Claude) that resolve them and open PRs. Built the LiveView kanban board and encrypted credential management.

aiagents.title: AI Coding Agents · Linear × Cursor
aiagents.tagline: AI agents (Linear + Cursor) on my repositories
aiagents.description: Set up and integrated Linear Agents and Cursor Background Agents with my repositories to automate development tasks: the agents pick up issues from Linear, resolve them in their Linux sandbox (where they can spin up and preview the app) and open the Pull Request on GitHub. For targets that require macOS + Xcode (Swift/iOS apps) I solved the incompatibility with an automated trigger that delegates execution to a local worker.

nurseloop.title: NurseLoop · Multi-tenant platform
nurseloop.description: Multi-tenant platform for nursing care agencies: shift, appointment and staff-assignment management, with granular access control by organization type and role. The longest-running project of my experience, in a team of 4 on Payload CMS and TypeScript.

gym.title: Gym Vitality
gym.description: Landing page for a gym with sections for services, plans and contact.

barber.title: Barber Shop
barber.description: Website for a barbershop with a work gallery, services and a contact section.

about.title: About me

about.bio2: I've built AI agent orchestrators integrated with Linear and GitHub to automate development tasks. In parallel I develop FinlyCR, my personal-finance app published on Google Play.
